issues.description: The solution defines assembleBookstore with a parameter (private static func assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore) but main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. The problem statement and the template's commented stub expect a no-argument assembleBookstore() (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore). This parameter mismatch will cause a compile-time error in the solution and is inconsistent with the template/problem expectation, which may confuse students when comparing template, spec, and solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the assembleBookstore signature consistent across artifacts. Either remove the seed parameter from the solution's assembleBookstore so it becomes private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore (matching the template and problem), or add a default value for the parameter (e.g. seed: Double = 0.0) and update the template/problem documentation accordingly. The simplest fix is to define assembleBookstore() with no parameters in the solution and call it without arguments.
